hints.en: Ask if you may examine him, then ask him to take off his shirt and put on the gown.
hints.es: ¿Me permite revisarlo? Quítese la camisa y póngase la bata, por favor.

hints.en: Ask him to sit on the exam table, then to lie down, relax and take a deep breath.
hints.es: Siéntese en la camilla, por favor. Ahora acuéstese, relájese y respire hondo.

hints.en: Say you're going to listen to his heart and lungs, and then check his ankles.
hints.es: Le voy a escuchar el corazón y los pulmones. Después le voy a revisar los tobillos.

hints.en: Say you'll put on some stickers that don't hurt or give shocks, and ask him not to move.
hints.es: Le voy a poner unos parches que no duelen ni dan toques. No se mueva, por favor.

roleplay.title: Going home with a heart monitor

hints.en: Reassure her that it won't give her shocks; it only records the heart rhythm.
hints.es: No, señora, no le va a dar toques. Solo graba el ritmo del corazón.

hints.en: Tell her that if she feels palpitations, she should press the button and write down the time and what she was doing.
hints.es: Si siente palpitaciones, apriete el botón y apunte la hora y lo que estaba haciendo.

hints.en: Tell her she can keep working, and if she showers or sweats a lot she should follow the monitor's instructions.
hints.es: Puede seguir trabajando. Si se baña o suda mucho, siga las instrucciones del monitor.

hints.en: Tell her to call 911 if she faints, has chest pain or is very short of breath.
hints.es: Si se desmaya, tiene dolor de pecho o mucha falta de aire, llame al 911.

hints.en: Explain that when she finishes she sends the monitor back, and you'll call her to give her the results.
hints.es: Al terminar, nos regresa el monitor y la vamos a llamar para darle los resultados.
